customManagers.description: decode-config: version pinned in the Dockerfile ARG and in the CI integration job (_checks.yml). The SHA-256 next to it cannot be computed by Renovate and must be updated by hand in the PR.

packageRules.description: One PR per ecosystem for minor and patch updates
The pinned Playwright container image (digest included, in _checks.yml, nightly.yml, pages.yml) and @playwright/test must match: one PR
The Go directive in go.mod and the golang build image move together
Major updates are never grouped: one PR each, to be read on their own

prBodyNotes: **Manual step:** Renovate cannot compute checksums of release assets. Update `DECODER_SHA256` in the Dockerfile and in `.github/workflows/_checks.yml` to the SHA-256 of `decode-config-ubuntu-24.04.tar.gz` of the new release (`curl -fsSL <asset url> | sha256sum`), or CI and the image build fail on the SHA-256 check.

If the release ships an aarch64 asset (tasmota/decode-config#127), also switch the arm64 stage from our fork build (`DECODER_ARM64_URL` / `DECODER_ARM64_SHA256`) to upstream's `decode-config-ubuntu-24.04-arm64.tar.gz`.
